comparison.objective: Infer cargo mass from size/material and load four blocks into ranked slots; candidate performs contact-driven HELICOIL finishing.
comparison.physical_skill: Material/volume reasoning and repeated block placement versus precision tool alignment, controlled impact, safe withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Four blocks occupy slots in descending mass order; candidate requires four physical notch failures, retained coils, complete tang containment, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Mass inference and ordered loading are meaningfully different from fracture-sensitive bimanual tool use. Slot tolerances are not specified.
